ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the financial document:  Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited reported strong year-over-year financial growth for Q2 and H1 FY2026-27 and declared a second interim dividend. However, a key concern is the six-month delay (from September 2026 to March 2027) of its ABS production capacity expansion project, attributed to global war scenarios causing supply chain issues and impacting equipment delivery. This delay, coupled with a sequential decline in Q2 profitability despite strong year-over-year gains, presents a material impact on future growth potential and warrants close monitoring.
